story: Sir Cedric is sent to retrieve the Heart of Lyria to stop the evil sorcerer Malakar. With the help of a small creature named Pippin, he faces magical challenges and proves his worth to a Phoenix guardian. After obtaining the artifact, Cedric returns to battle Malakar and saves the kingdom through courage and determination.
